intent: Make the Foshan Three.js viewer useful without paid photogrammetry by defaulting to an open-data-first photorealistic hybrid pipeline while preserving truthfulness about estimated geometry.
constraints: No Overpass/OSM building extrusion may be presented as the default high-fidelity building source.
Missing height data must be explicitly treated as an estimate, never as surveyed truth.
No paid API key is required for the default demo path.
nonGoals: Claiming procedural facades reproduce the real windows of every Foshan building.
Bundling copyrighted landmark models without a compatible license.

requirements.statement: The default building source is the official Overture Buildings PMTiles release and is loaded by viewport.
Building height uses Overture height or floor count before deterministic visual estimation, and the UI reports data-backed coverage.
The default no-key mode renders terrain elevation and satellite imagery and dynamically changes tile LOD as the camera moves.
The project contains no random-height fallback or fake landmark model presented as real.

checks.description: Static syntax, geometry, height-resolution, and policy acceptance tests pass.
Public Overture, Terrarium, and EOX endpoints respond for the Foshan viewport.
